nodes.label: Google Analytics & Ads
nodes.rationale: Google Analytics G-KDTSZDK and Google Ads AW-784815915 tags loaded via GTM-MGWDTFB. Analytics.js also loaded directly. Universal Analytics (non-GA4) appears to be in use based on analytics.js reference.

nodes.label: Facebook Pixel
nodes.rationale: Facebook Pixel ID 1190053246161173. Loads connect.facebook.net/en_US/fbevents.js for conversion tracking and retargeting.

nodes.label: Microsoft Clarity
nodes.rationale: Microsoft Clarity tracking ID ihcny69ubz. Loads clarity.js 0.8.65 for session recording and heatmap analytics.

nodes.label: Google Tag Manager
nodes.rationale: Google Tag Manager container GTM-MGWDTFB loaded on all pages. Orchestrates Google Analytics, Google Ads, and other tracking tags.

nodes.label: 404 Not Found Page
nodes.rationale: Two URLs resolve to the Shopify 404 page: pages/sitemap and collections/bf-basic-not-loaded. Both show title '404 Not Found' and canonical https://www.madsencycles.com/404 with no breadcrumb beyond Home.

nodes.label: Stamped.io Reviews
nodes.rationale: Stamped.io reviews widget (files/widget.min.css) loaded on the 404 page. Suggests product review functionality is integrated site-wide for customer reviews.
